problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate a circuit for its fleet of autonomous drones to inspect twelve critical communication nodes.  
The nodes are positioned at these precise geographic coordinates:  

Node Alpha: (136,188)  
Node Beta: (175,180)  
Node Gamma: (118,194)  
Node Delta: (10,144)  
Node Epsilon: (31,104)  
Node Zeta: (99,43)

Node Kappa: (187,179)  
Node Lambda: (37,20)

Due to a permanent signal interference, no direct flight path exists between Node Alpha and Node Beta.  
Furthermore, owing to overlapping frequency bands, exactly one of the two following links must be incorporated into the inspection loop: the connection between Beta and Gamma, or the connection between Gamma and Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal‑distance closed loop that visits every node precisely once and returns to the origin.
